name: forward-hourly-splines-v1
initializer: Same neutral source-cost-anchored six-node curve in all months; no inherited target-fitted parameters
transfer: Exact equal-weight mean economic markup functions by zone/technology/local hour of week over available training hours. Unsupported slots use own-month mean; absent resources use neutral prior. New-month source costs, MW, demand, constraints and fixed hydro remain actual hourly inputs.
selection: Common epoch minimizing all8016 next-month original-LP hourly price MAE across41 complete zones; generation trains each monthly fit but does not select epoch. Stop after3 consecutive nonimproving epochs. Retain best12 monthly models.
scope: Retrospective perfect-input forward model-selection validation, not untouched testing or an operational forecast. December2025 fit has no January2026 validation. No wrap, baseline promotion or public-explorer change.
